proposed_title: Validate and assure AI-generated environmental analyses before decision use
description: Tests AI outputs against field ground truth, regulatory requirements and independent sources; documents error modes, fitness-for-purpose and residual uncertainty; decides when outputs may not be used.
rationale: Robust in all four scenarios (no-regret). v1 7.2.1 exists but is DC-only and lacks proficiency levels tied to decision stakes; expand into a full cross-family competency with observable indicators (IO).

proposed_title: Specify, test and monitor AI tools used in environmental decisions (model risk management)
description: Defines intended use, acceptance tests, performance monitoring and drift triggers for AI and models in permitting, enforcement targeting and monitoring; classifies high-impact uses.
rationale: OMB M-25-21 and agency AI strategies create the function; distinct from validating single outputs (FS-C01). Highest value in SC1 and SC3.

proposed_title: Maintain AI provenance and a defensible administrative record under accelerated review
description: Records data lineage, which analyses were AI-assisted, human review steps and responses to substantive comments so that records survive shorter deadlines and judicial review.
rationale: SPEED Act provisions (150-day limitations, substantive-comment requirement) plus AI drafting create a new failure point; speculative until courts address AI-assisted records.

proposed_title: Design and steward ground-truth reference data for Earth-observation and AI models
description: Plans field plots and labelled samples, maintains reference datasets and metadata, and runs regional validation to establish where models are fit for use.
rationale: EO foundation-model evidence shows labels and regional validation remain binding; gives field craft a durable role in AI-era monitoring (no-regret).

proposed_title: Fuse multi-source fire intelligence into operational decision support
description: Integrates satellite detections, cameras, weather, fuels and resource status into continuous situational awareness and briefings for initial attack, resource ordering and public warning.
rationale: FireSat early-adopter data from Q4 2026 and utility/state intelligence centers; connects to v1 WFIC/F16 work.

proposed_title: Plan and govern BVLOS and autonomous field operations programs
description: Designs drone and robotic monitoring programs: concept of operations, airspace and safety management, data pipelines, maintenance and crew qualification.
rationale: Program-level competency distinct from piloting (v1 4.5.4); timing contingent on Part 108 final rule.

proposed_title: Verify environmental claims using digital MRV with field calibration
description: Audits remote-sensing and sensor-based estimates, dynamic baselines and uncertainty; designs targeted field sampling to calibrate and challenge digital estimates; judges additionality and permanence claims digital data cannot prove.
rationale: Verification is platformizing; competency keeps human judgment where digital evidence is weakest.

proposed_title: Calibrate assessor judgment and measure inter-rater reliability in field assessments
description: Runs calibration exercises, measures agreement between assessors, and adjusts protocols so condition scores, surveys and credit metrics reflect real ecological change.
rationale: Assessor variability alone can generate a 10% BNG uplift; the same skill underpins defensible EMST tagging (IO lane).

proposed_title: Own and steward a public environmental technology product
description: Applies product management to case-management, permitting and monitoring systems: user research with practitioners, backlog and roadmap, data-standard compliance, adoption and change management.
rationale: CEQ data standard and Innovation Center create the need; FAS/EPIC called for product managers; agencies rarely have this role.

proposed_title: Procure and manage environmental technology and data contracts that protect public data rights
description: Writes requirements, evaluates vendors, negotiates data ownership, model access, auditability and exit terms, and manages performance of technology and data-service contracts.
rationale: Critical in Platform Stewardship (SC3) where public agencies become intelligent customers of private and philanthropic data; useful everywhere.

proposed_title: Steward an environmental digital twin across its lifecycle
description: Maintains data assimilation, validation under nonstationary conditions, uncertainty communication, access governance and retirement decisions for operational digital twins.
rationale: Watch-state candidate: v1 2.7.3 covers development but not operational stewardship; operational demand 5-10y.

proposed_title: Elicit, document and transfer tacit field and institutional knowledge before cohort exit
description: Uses structured interviews, paired fieldwork, after-action reviews and recorded field walks to transfer place-based and institutional knowledge from departing experts; respects Indigenous knowledge governance.
rationale: EPA departing median tenure 30.3 years; robust in all scenarios; urgent in SC4. Tribal knowledge only on holders' terms (TN).

proposed_title: Design AI-augmented apprenticeships that preserve the learning substrate
description: Redesigns entry-level work so juniors still produce, field-check and defend analyses while using AI; measures learning outcomes as well as throughput.
rationale: Directly counters v1 CLD signals; v1 7.2.2 is the seed. Robust across scenarios (no-regret).

proposed_title: Negotiate and administer intergovernmental stewardship agreements
description: Structures and manages co-stewardship, Good Neighbor, self-governance (638) and state-based leadership agreements: authorities, funding, performance and dispute resolution.
rationale: Devolution and Tribal assertion of governmental roles make agreement craft central; v1 splits it across 6.5.x without agreement lifecycle management.

proposed_title: Scan horizons and translate weak signals into workforce decisions
description: Monitors signals, maintains scenarios, runs foresight sessions and converts findings into no-regret and contingent workforce moves with triggers.
rationale: Distinguish from 6.2.5 (policy scenario analysis) and 1.7.5 (ecological non-analog futures); needed by EMST's own sentinels and by workforce planners.

proposed_title: Translate climate-risk data into navigable adaptation options for communities
description: Turns hazard, exposure and funding information into options small jurisdictions and households can act on; brokers technical assistance as federal support thins.
rationale: Speculative role signal; confirm with state/local posting data (SL, IA).

proposed_title: Design domain tasks and grading rubrics for evaluating environmental AI
description: Creates realistic multi-step environmental work tasks, reference answers and rubrics used to train, test and red-team AI agents.
rationale: Paid market already exists (Jun 2026); same skill supports agency acceptance testing (FS-C02).

proposed_title: Prepare assurance-ready GHG and nature disclosures across divergent regimes
description: Builds auditable inventories and nature metrics that satisfy SB 253, ESRS and ISSB-aligned requirements simultaneously; manages assurance.
rationale: v1 3.6.2 names GRI/SASB/TCFD (TCFD now absorbed into ISSB): rewrite around durable function, tools/frameworks in tool layer (DC lane).
